newsitem.title: TURKEY: BASKETBALL-TURKEY'S BESIKTAS WANT GREEKS PUNISHED FOR BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-TURKEY'S BESIKTAS WANT GREEKS PUNISHED FOR BRAWL.

text.p: Turkey's Besiktas basketball club called on Monday for a heavy fine to be imposed on Greek rivals Aris following a brawl at a Korac Cup match between the two teams last week.

The match was abandoned after a fight broke out between Besiktas's American forward Gary Alexander and Dino Angelides of Aris. Other players and Greek supporters joined in the scuffle and the Turkish team fled to the changing rooms.

"If FIBA (basketball's governing body) does not heavily fine Aris club, or lets them off their fine, we believe this will open the way to even more headaches in the future," a Besiktas statement said.
Besiktas spokesman Aydin Ayadin said: "Since we were not the hosts and not one of our supporters was present our club cannot be held responsible for the incident."
Alexander was charged with assault after the game by Greek authorities and Angelides filed a suit against him.
FIBA are expected to consider the incident next week.
